results.title: Medieval cottage architecture guide
highlights: A medieval cottage often uses timber framing, stone foundations, and a steep thatched roof.
Common colors include warm brown wood, pale plaster walls, gray stone, and golden straw.

results.title: Thatched roof farmhouse references
highlights: Thatched roofs have rounded edges and layered straw textures.
The roof mass is usually larger than the wall mass, creating a cozy silhouette.

results.title: Minecraft-style cottage ideas
results.text: Blocky cottages use oak logs, planks, cobblestone, stairs, slabs, and hay blocks.
highlights: Minecraft cottage builds usually exaggerate the roof and keep the walls compact.

results.title: Historic timber framing
highlights: Timber framing creates strong vertical and diagonal dark wood lines across pale wall panels.

results.title: Stone chimney references
highlights: Small medieval homes often have a rough gray stone chimney rising above one side of the roof.
